_doc: Physical sheet of S.B.R mk2: the single source for every simulator (MuJoCo now, Isaac later). Units: SI. See docs/hardware.md for where each number comes from.

body._L: measured by the pendulum test (T = 0.61 s); sets the pitch inertia: I_axle = L * m * d
body._size: visual box only (depth x, width y, height z); does not affect mass or inertia

wheel._track: geometric, center to center; turns measured 0.160 effective (tire slip)

motor._torque_limit: N*m per wheel; GUESS (driver Vref never measured). Above it the wheel can't follow: the sim's version of missed steps
motor._servo_gain: N*m per rad/s: how stiffly the wheel follows the commanded speed. 5 made the servo chatter against the torque limit and shake the robot down; 0.2 tracks within ~0.01 cm/s
motor._rotor_inertia: kg*m^2 added to each wheel joint (MuJoCo armature): NEMA17 rotor ~5.4e-6 + wheel hub; raised to 5e-5 so the stiff stepper servo stays numerically clean at a 1 ms step

_disturbance_torque: N*m, random pitch torque on the body every 5 ms (motor vibration, backlash, floor). Calibrated so BOTH controllers wobble like the real robot standing still (PID ±3.5 cm, LQR ±0.5 cm)
